doc: Madden 27 (PC) screens for the pilot (docs/in_progress/MADDEN_PILOT_AND_TUNING_PLAN.md section 2.2).
Words are what Windows OCR read in spikes P-a and P-b (C:/Madden27Modding/MuPilot/spike/). Matching is upper-case, punctuation-blind and bounded by whole words inside one OCR line.
classify() takes the FIRST screen whose 'all' words are all present, at least one 'any' word is present (when 'any' is listed) and no 'none' word is present, so order matters: most specific first.
keys: logical names used in exits and press(); select is Space and is only ever pressed through confirm_on().

exits: {TARGET: [step, ...]}. A step is [key, times] (a logical or raw key), ['hold', KEY] (hold the key ~1.2 s, for Madden's HOLD TO DELEGATE), ['highlight', LABEL] (move the highlight onto LABEL along 'nav') or ['confirm', LABEL] (confirm_on this screen with LABEL).
confirm_ok: the labels Space may accept on this screen (fnmatch patterns, e.g. TUNE-*). An empty list means Space is never pressed here.
options / default / nav: the choices on the screen in on-screen order, the one highlighted on arrival, and the axis the arrow keys move along (vertical: up/down, horizontal: left/right).

highlight: how to tell which option is highlighted. 'border' = Madden draws a white outline (and on dialogs a light fill) around the selected option, so the screenshot is read: the option with a bright line running along its width just above or below its OCR box wins (screens.border_highlight; 'border_reach' sets how far, as a fraction of the height, default 0.06). OCR alone can't tell. 'ocr_order' = the highlight can't be read from the picture, so the pilot assumes 'default' on arrival and counts its own arrow presses through 'options' (in on-screen OCR order). null = no options; Space just continues.

Flags: forbidden (whole screen: stop on sight), forbidden_keys (keys never pressed here, e.g. q = Delete on the franchise list), forbidden_confirm (Space is refused here unless the pilot is given a policy for this screen), quit_guard (the confirm label that quits a franchise; refused unless the loaded franchise starts with TUNE- or allow_quit is passed, because quitting writes <save>-AUTOSAVE), loads_franchise (confirming here loads the highlighted franchise), wait_or_back (a video: Backspace steps through it and the frames between are UNKNOWN), repeat (how many times the pilot may land on this same screen in a row while leaving it, e.g. three progress tabs), never_select (Space is never pressed here; no policy can lift it), no_route (never a goto target or a hop), todo (not seen yet or not fully mapped; words are guesses).

DELETE_CONFIRM.note: Not seen. Any dialog about deleting a franchise stops the run.

QUIT_CONFIRM.note: Spike b3: Back on the hub. NO is highlighted on arrival; Up then Space chooses YES, which writes <save>-AUTOSAVE and returns to CURRENT FRANCHISES. 2026-11-10: Windows OCR does not read the NO label at all, so the cancel route is Backspace (the dialog closes exactly as NO does); YES is still found and bordered.
all: ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO QUIT

SAVEPOINT_OVERWRITE.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): after choosing an existing save in SAVEPOINT_DIALOG, FILE OPERATION asks 'Are you sure you want to overwrite TUNE-P2A in System Storage?' with NO selected.

SAVEPOINT_DIALOG.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): Tab (Create Savepoint) opens a SAVE AS list — FILE NAME / DATE / TYPE, 'NEW...' selected at the top and the saves newest first below (matching the folder's mtime order). Select a TUNE-* name to overwrite it, or NEW... to type a new one (the name entry dialog is not catalogued yet). Space saves, Backspace backs out.

PROGRESSION_WARNING.note: Spike b6: loading a franchise offline. Drawn over CURRENT FRANCHISES, so it comes before FRANCHISE_LIST. Proceed is highlighted on arrival; the franchise loads in about 25 s.

ROSTER_DECISION_PROMPT.note: Spike c4: Space on a Weekly Hub roster-decision card. Never selected (JR, 2026-10-30): the cards are optional content, not interrupts, and Project Mu makes every roster decision through the save writer, never in Madden. Not a target of any exit; if the pilot ever lands here it backs out. Space accepts the highlighted choice (one blind Space put R. Walker on IR in the spike), so it is refused.

COACH_PROGRESS.note: Spike b10, c1: after a simmed week. The only screen that interrupts Advance Week > Next Week (JR, 2026-10-30). JR (2026-10-31): a team setting turns off the ability recap; with it off there's no interrupt between weeks and Advance Week > Next Week lands straight on the next week's Weekly Hub. Turn it off in the baseline save so every CAREER-TUNE-* clone inherits it; the pilot still handles this screen when it's on.  Three tabs (COACH PROGRESS, LOADOUT PROGRESS, UNLOCKS); Space (CONTINUE) steps through each, then the Weekly Hub.

WEEKLY_RECAP.note: Recovery screen only: it never plays on its own (JR, 2026-10-30); it started in the spike (e2-h1) only because a Space landed on GAMEDAY's WEEKLY RECAP tile, which is why HUB_GAMEDAY confirms only ADVANCE WEEK and only with the highlight read on it. Backspace steps one segment; most frames have no text (UNKNOWN). Neither Space nor Esc skips it.

FORCE_ADVANCE_CONFIRM.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-01): confirming FORCE ADVANCE in the all-user league opens ATTENTION / 'You have selected to skip ahead multiple weeks. Are you sure you wish to continue?' with SIM AHEAD and CANCEL (CANCEL selected). Up then Space on SIM AHEAD.

ADVANCE_MENU.note: Spike b9, revisited for the all-user league 2026-11-10 (P2-01): Space on ADVANCE WEEK opens READY TO ADVANCE / FORCE ADVANCE, then JUMP AHEAD / SIM TO MIDSEASON. With all 32 teams user-controlled READY TO ADVANCE cannot run the week; one Down then Space on FORCE ADVANCE does (JR). The menu draws over GAMEDAY, so HUB_GAMEDAY and HUB_WEEKLY exclude READY TO ADVANCE.

CHOOSE_TEAM.note: Spike P-a look1: the in-franchise create-new-character team choice (OFFLINE > NFL PRESEASON ROSTER > CHOOSE TEAM > CUSTOMIZE). E = Random Team. Nothing is ever chosen here; Back's target wasn't seen.

FRANCHISE_LIST.note: Spike b5: CURRENT FRANCHISES. Tiles show save names without CAREER- (TUNE-SPIKE, ALLUSER, ...), newest first; Left/Right move; the highlight is a white border. Q = DELETE.

DRAFT_LAUNCH.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): after START THE NFL DRAFT, the page asks to kick off the 2027 draft with START DRAFTING and SIMULATE DRAFT. Project Mu has already written its picks into the save, so the pilot takes SIMULATE DRAFT and never drafts by hand (JR: 'click Draft and then click Simulate Draft'). Windows OCR reads the label as SIMULATEDRAFT.

DRAFT_HUB.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): draft week replaces the GAMEDAY and WEEKLY HUB tabs with a DRAFT tab next to MANAGE ROSTER (JR). It holds the NFL DRAFT logo and one START THE NFL DRAFT button. Project Mu writes the picks into the save first; the pilot opens the draft and then simulates it (JR: 'click Draft and then click Simulate Draft').

HUB_OTHER.note: The MANAGE ROSTER, COACH CENTRAL, LEAGUE and OPTIONS hub tabs. Anchored on GAMEDAY plus the tab PAGE's own words (2026-11-10): requiring COACH CENTRAL failed when OCR garbled it ('COACHCENTUL'), and the page then matched HUB_GAMEDAY instead and the pilot walked itself onto another tab. Z steps back one tab toward GAMEDAY.

ADVANCE_LOCKED.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): the GAMEDAY tab at the Free agency stop. 'ADVANCE WEEK LOCKED / The Free Agent Frenzy event has 10 hours remaining' is drawn over the standings page with one OK button, and there is no ADVANCE WEEK to highlight. This is JR's free-agency live event: the LIVE EVENT tab (one left of GAMEDAY) has to be dealt with before the week can advance.

FREE_AGENCY_ENDED.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): after SIMULATE TO END OF FRENZY, 'FREE AGENT FRENZY ENDED / The Free Agent Frenzy event has ended. You can no longer negotiate with players.' with one OK button, drawn over the live-event page. Dismiss it and the week can advance again.

LIVE_EVENT_FRENZY_MODAL.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): holding Escape on the LIVE EVENT tab opens 'ADVANCE FREE AGENT FRENZY / Currently on hour 1. Advance to hour 2?' with ADVANCE TO NEXT HOUR (selected), SIMULATE TO END OF FRENZY and CANCEL (JR; Windows OCR drops the END and reads SIMULATE TO OF FRENZY, so the label is anchored on SIMULATE TO). SIMULATE TO END OF FRENZY is the only one the pilot may take: it ends the event, which is what unlocks the week.

LIVE_EVENT_FRENZY.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-02): the LIVE EVENT tab at the Free agent frenzy stop (one tab left of GAMEDAY, the Z icon). It is a free-agent contract board (P.NACUA, SALARY OVERVIEW, DESIRED YEARS) and Project Mu owns every contract decision, so Space is never pressed here. Holding Escape opens LIVE_EVENT_FRENZY_MODAL (JR's skip for the free-agency live event).

HUB_GAMEDAY.note: Spike b8, e1: the GAMEDAY tab (MATCHUP). Buttons left to right: [WEEKLY RECAP after a played week], ADVANCE WEEK, PLAY SEASON GAME (order changes between weeks; the highlight is a white border). Space only on ADVANCE WEEK. MATCHUP is NOT a matching word any more (2026-11-10): the News Center ticker says 'matchup' on every hub tab, so a blank Weekly Hub frame matched here, the pilot pressed C to reach HUB_WEEKLY and landed on MANAGE ROSTER instead.

HUB_WEEKLY_DRAFT_CARD.note: Weekly Hub with the Week 1 draft-class card selected (2026-11-10, P2-01): 'WHICH ROOKIES WILL WE SEE IN APRIL'S DRAFT?'. Madden refuses to advance the week until it is delegated: hold Q (footer reads HOLD TO DELEGATE) — JR. Space is never pressed here; Q is allowed on this screen only, and the season loop holds it before reading the week.

HUB_BYE.note: Seen 2026-11-10: the Weekly Hub on the user team's bye week — the tab row and BYE WEEK, no matchup line and no week number anywhere (the 2026-11-10 season run stopped here: nothing matched, goto spun on UNKNOWN until its timeout). The week is known only from the save, so jobs omits the header hunt on this screen and infers +1 from the autosave written by the advance.

HUB_WEEKLY.note: Spike b1, d1: the WEEKLY HUB tab (2026. WEEK 1 / VS BEARS). Its cards (roster decisions included) are optional content, never selected (JR, 2026-10-30); Space on one opens ROSTER_DECISION_PROMPT, so Space is never pressed here. Q = HOLD TO DELEGATE (forbidden until delegation is a deliberate policy). The hub doesn't show the save name. Anchored on the whole tab row 2026-11-10 (P2-01): the highlighted WEEKLY HUB tab reads as nothing in OCR (step 0045 of 2026-11-10_015210_sim-season), so requiring it flipped the loaded hub to UNKNOWN.

BOOT_SPLASH.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2 reproduction): the cold-boot splash before the EA/MADDEN title — PRESS ANY BUTTON with the Frostbite/EA copyright line. One Space continues.

TITLE_SCREEN.note: Seen 2026-11-10 in the P2-01 retries: EA SPORTS / MADDEN NFL title with PRESS ANY BUTTON. The button sits below the captured client area (step 0021 of 2026-11-10_014049_sim-season), so OCR only reads the MADDEN logo; the screen is matched on that word with every menu/hub word excluded. One Space continues to the main menu; nothing else on this screen can be chosen.

FRANCHISE_LANDING.note: Seen 2026-11-10 (P2-01, full-screen capture after the driver was made DPI-aware): the Franchise mode page with three cards. CONTINUE is selected on arrival and resumes the last-played save; Right then Space on CREATE / LOAD opens CURRENT FRANCHISES (JR: 'it needs to go right ... hit Create and Load, not Continue'). The border reader picks CONTINUE correctly on arrival.

MAIN_MENU_RAIL.note: Seen 2026-11-10: the main-menu mode rail on a non-Franchise mode (ULTIMATE TEAM and its sub-tabs). JR: one Down moves ULTIMATE TEAM -> FRANCHISE; from other modes the pilot presses Down until FRANCHISE_LANDING appears (jobs._load_franchise).

MAIN_MENU.note: Observed G0 2026-11-01 main-menu Franchise selection; words re-anchored 2026-11-10 after a P2-01 run (parse step 0002 of 2026-11-10_013118_sim-season) where stylised AUTHENTIC read as LUTHENTIC and flipped the screen to UNKNOWN. JR 2026-11-10: the mode rail is vertical and one Down press moves ULTIMATE TEAM -> FRANCHISE, which is how a run starting on another mode can reach this screen (not yet modelled as an exit). Only Franchise may be confirmed; other modes are not authorized.
